mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) AS sessions, COUNT(DISTINCT s.member_id) AS members, COALESCE(SUM(s.distance_m), 0) AS distanceM, COALESCE(SUM(s.tiles_revealed), 0) AS tilesRevealed, COALESCE(SUM(s.pois_found), 0) AS poisFound, COALESCE(SUM(s.status = 0), 0) AS open FROM roam_session s
SELECT COUNT(1) AS revealedCells, COUNT(DISTINCT f.member_id) AS members, COALESCE(SUM(f.last_revealed_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)), 0) AS touchedLast7Days FROM roam_member_fog_cell f
